title: The Rule and Exercises of Holy Living
author: Jeremy Taylor
tradition_notes: Jeremy Taylor (1613–1667), Anglican bishop and chaplain to King Charles I, wrote Holy Living (1650) as a comprehensive guide to practical piety during the Interregnum. With Holy Dying (1651), these two works constitute the classic Anglican treatment of holy life and Christian death.
source_edition: The Rule and Exercises of Holy Living. Philadelphia: J. W. Bradley, 1860. CCEL edition.
